_comment: Per-project identity, read by SkylotusCI.ConfigureProject. An empty string means 'fall back', so the blank fields below are the ones a new project has to fill in. Keys this file does not define are ignored, and environment variables (SKYLOTUS_PRODUCT_NAME and friends) still win over everything here.
_iconComment: Blank uses the convention slot Assets/Resources/Icon/icon.png. Set this only to keep the icon somewhere else.
